messages.text:
"Let's build a game where we are transmigrated into a world of magic. In this world, there are magic of fire, water, earth/nature, wind. And more deep, like light and dark magic, and every variation one can think coming from these. There are rare mages that can move into dreams, other can talk to the dead. There are mages that can perform astral projections, and others can teleport.

The world is divided by the aristocracy. The rich wants to be richer putting all the wheight of the chores onto de backs of the poor people. That way, to prevent people revolting, they allowed only the rich to practice magic, while the poor are hunted. 

There are 7 tiers of magic power, and its defined in birth. When the kid becomes 12 years old, being boy or girl, they go into a ceremony performed by 5 tier magic masters to see how much magic power they have. 

For the rich is a day of hope, for the poor, a day of disgrace. The rich can move classes, the poor is hunted.

There are also all sort of monsters, like goblins, orcs, dragons, big ants and wasps, inteligent animals like walking lizards, and walking pigs, and all sort of fantastical monsters. 

The practioners of dark magic seek the power of demons, who wants to get rid of all humankind. Ant try to use those that want to be used, especially in places of power. However, they are also hunted by specialized mages of light. 

There's also all sort of weapons specialization.

To use magic, one needs to form cores around their hearts. Every tier needs a new core. And trying to reach more power also comes with lots of danger because one heart could not handle the burst of power well. 

There's a very big city called Antrovia. Its the center of the continent, and the place with most magic schools. Alchemy is well known here. With the monster cores people can produce magic cloths and weapons. Magic cores are very precious. 

There are always rumors of wars between the 3 continents that share borders. Spies everywhere. 

The most important thing for a mage/magician is hemisphere creativity in using magic in his own way. A fireball casted by two different people of the same tier can be different in power, range, form, etc. Creativity plays a big role. 

Makes can also write runes in equipment and in their bodies to improve certain physical skills, or as protections/shields.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable game from the user’s transmigration-into-a-world-of-magic setting.

## Requirements
- Include elemental and rare magic, seven-tier heart cores and their risks, class oppression, monsters, Antrovia, alchemy, runes, weapons, spies, and intercontinental tensions.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser RPG in `index.html`, with turn-based combat, branching narrative choices, local save/resume, and responsive layout.
- Scope is a playable first chapter ending at Tier Two; the epilogue signals the larger world and remaining tiers.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a playable narrative arc: character origin and elemental affinity selection, Twelfth-Year Rite, three fights, story choices, core advancement, and an ending.
- Added elemental combat styles, healing items, Light/Dark options at Tier Two, rare magic talents, renown/coin/resources, and save/resume/restart.
- Verified JavaScript syntax with `node --check` and smoke-tested a complete playthrough in headless Chromium.

### Active
- Adding selectable weapon specializations (Blade, Bow, Spear, Staff). `weapon:'Blade'` has been added to initial state, but weapon-choice UI and combat effects are not yet implemented.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Finish weapon specialization selection and wire each style into combat.
2. Re-run syntax validation and a browser smoke test.
3. Summarize the game and note the first-chapter scope and other brief assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game implementation; current active work is weapon specialization.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A complete smoke test reached “A NEW DAWN”; the tested build was before the latest partial weapon-state edit.

Implemented the weapon specialization system in `index.html`:

- Added Blade, Bow, Spear, and Staff choices at character creation.
- Gave each weapon a distinct combat effect, shown in its selection description and combat UI.
- Saved the selected weapon with the game and displayed it in the character status.

**Verified:** JavaScript syntax check passed, and a headless Chromium smoke test confirmed Staff selection and its discounted spell cost in combat.

The game remains a self-contained browser RPG. I kept the scope to a complete first chapter ending at Tier Two; the epilogue points toward the wider world and higher tiers.
